note: The unit here is the VOLUME, not the page. All 987 pages of volume 1 were cropped, laid out and walked; the 2,579 cards kept are the ones whose body names Chicago, Cook County or Illinois, and the other ~56,000 are read and not kept. Declaring 987 pages would be a lie in the other direction — it would report a hole on every page that carries no Illinois family, and there are 344 of them.
